mathematics.assertion_tested: An explicit constrained auxiliary action yields p=lambda*y/(1+lambda*y), mu=1-(1-p)^2 and kappa=1/(2lambda); equal weights yield unit response and kappa=1/2. Independent action and fixed-vacuum counterfamilies retain the normalization freedom.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Exact symbolic real arithmetic in SymPy; real algebra and derivatives in Lean
mathematics.conventions: G,s,lambda positive; y=|gradPhi|/s nonnegative; auxiliary field domain 0<qi<=1; action minus [s²W/(8piG)+rhoPhi]; no dark-particle or observational input.

bounds.symbolic: Exact identities and real limits; complete positive-lambda family, explicit excluded stationary branches as negative controls, finite list of algebraic derivative checks.
bounds.lean: 14 named theorems; source-to-action bridge symbolic outside Lean. Real derivative of rational extension at zero implies physical right derivative.
bounds.resources: 60 second wall clock; cooperative single-thread cap; no finite numerical sweep or dynamical integration.

non_claims: No independent physical derivation selecting lambda=1.
No covariant action completion, global dynamical stability, cosmology, or observational fit.
No global novelty or priority claim.
No assertion that the existing particle-free action forces kappa=1/2.
